title: The races of the Grand Raid — The Diagonale des Fous route
claims: The English race overview lists the Diagonale des Fous route as 170 km with 10,500 m of positive gain.
The same overview lists five Grand Raid races: Diagonale des Fous, Trail de Bourbon, Mascareignes, Métis Trail and Zembrocal Trail.
The overview distances for the other races are 100 km, 70 km, 50 km and 151 km respectively.
